```lean
import Mathlib

/-- The least positive integer `n` such that `77` divides `(n + 2) * (n + 3)`.
Must be a numeric literal. -/
abbrev p07_answer : ℕ := 19

/-- `p07_answer` is the least element of the set of positive `n` with
`77 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3)`. -/
theorem p07_least_divisible :
    IsLeast {n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ 77 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3)} p07_answer := by
  -- First we show that `19` satisfies the required property.
  have hpos : (0 : ℕ) < p07_answer := by decide
  have hdiv : 77 ∣ (p07_answer + 2) * (p07_answer + 3) := by
    -- compute the product and exhibit a witness
    refine ⟨6, ?_⟩
    norm_num
  have hmem : p07_answer ∈ {n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ 77 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3)} := by
    exact ⟨hpos, hdiv⟩
  refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
  -- Now we prove minimality: any `n` with the property satisfies `19 ≤ n`.
  intro n hn
  rcases hn with ⟨hnpos, hndiv⟩
  -- From `77 ∣ (n+2)*(n+3)` we obtain divisibility by the primes `7` and `11`.
  have h7div : 7 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3) := by
    rcases hndiv with ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨11 * k, ?_⟩
    have h77 : (77 : ℕ) = 7 * 11 := by norm_num
    simpa [h77, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc] using hk
  have h11div : 11 ∣ (n + 2) * (n + 3) := by
    rcases hndiv with ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨7 * k, ?_⟩
    have h77 : (77 : ℕ) = 7 * 11 := by norm_num
    simpa [h77, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc] using hk
  -- Primality of `7` and `11`.
  have h7prime : Nat.Prime 7 := by decide
  have h11prime : Nat.Prime 11 := by decide
  -- From primality we get the possible divisors of the two consecutive numbers.
  rcases (h7prime.dvd_mul.1 h7div) with h7a | h7b
  rcases (h11prime.dvd_mul.1 h11div) with h11a | h11b
  · -- 7 ∣ n+2, 11 ∣ n+2  → 77 ∣ n+2
    rcases h7a with ⟨a, ha⟩
    rcases h11a with ⟨b, hb⟩
    have : (n + 2) = 77 * a := by
      have : (n + 2) = 7 * a := ha
      have : (n + 2) = 11 * b := hb
      -- both expressions equal `n+2`, hence `7*a = 11*b`; from this we get a multiple of 77
      have h : 7 * a = 11 * b := by
        calc
          7 * a = n + 2 := ha.symm
          _ = 11 * b := hb
      have : a = 11 * (b / 7) := by
        -- since `7 ∣ 11 * b` and `gcd 7 11 = 1`, we get `7 ∣ b`
        have h7b : 7 ∣ b := by
          have : 7 ∣ 7 * a := ⟨a, rfl⟩
          have : 7 ∣ 11 * b := by
            simpa [h] using this
          exact Nat.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (Nat.coprime_one_left _) this
        rcases h7b with ⟨c, hc⟩
        have : b = 7 * c := hc.symm
        simpa [this, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc] using rfl
      sorry
    -- from `n+2 ≥ 77` we get the desired inequality
    have hge : 21 ≤ n + 2 := by
      have : 77 ≤ n + 2 := by
        have : (n + 2) = 77 * a := by simpa [ha] using ha
        have : 77 * a ≥ 77 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 77 (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by decide)))
        simpa [this] using this
      exact Nat.le_trans (by decide) this
    have h19lt : 19 < n + 2 := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide) hge
    have h19le_n1 : 19 ≤ n + 1 := Nat.le_of_lt_succ h19lt
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ h19le_n1
  · -- 7 ∣ n+2, 11 ∣ n+3
    rcases h7a with ⟨a, ha⟩
    rcases h11b with ⟨b, hb⟩
    -- From `n+3 = 11 * b` we get `n+2 ≡ -1 [MOD 11]`.
    have hmod11 : (n + 2) ≡ 10 [MOD 11] := by
      have : n + 3 ≡ 0 [MOD 11] := (Nat.ModEq.zero_iff_dvd).2 h11b
      simpa [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc] using this.sub_left (by decide)
    -- From `n+2 = 7 * a` we have `n+2 ≡ 0 [MOD 7]`.
    have hmod7 : (n + 2) ≡ 0 [MOD 7] := (Nat.ModEq.zero_iff_dvd).2 h7a
    -- Solve the simultaneous congruences; the smallest solution is 21.
    have h21 : 21 ≤ n + 2 := by
      have : (n + 2) ≡ 21 [MOD 77] := by
        have h := Nat.ModEq.of_mul_left (Nat.succ_pos 10) (Nat.ModEq.trans hmod7 (by decide))
        sorry
      have : (n + 2) ≥ 21 := by
        have : (n + 2) % 77 = 21 % 77 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by decide)] using this
        have : (n + 2) % 77 = 21 := by simpa using this
        exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide))
      exact this
    have h19lt : 19 < n + 2 := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide) h21
    have h19le_n1 : 19 ≤ n + 1 := Nat.le_of_lt_succ h19lt
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ h19le_n1
  · -- 7 ∣ n+3, 11 ∣ n+2
    rcases h7b with ⟨a, ha⟩
    rcases h11a with ⟨b, hb⟩
    -- Similar to the previous case, the smallest solution is 55, hence ≥21.
    have h55 : 55 ≤ n + 2 := by
      have : (n + 2) ≡ 55 [MOD 77] := by
        sorry
      have : (n + 2) ≥ 55 := by
        have : (n + 2) % 77 = 55 % 77 := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by decide)] using this
        have : (n + 2) % 77 = 55 := by simpa using this
        exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide))
      exact this
    have h19lt : 19 < n + 2 := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide) h55
    have h19le_n1 : 19 ≤ n + 1 := Nat.le_of_lt_succ h19lt
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ h19le_n1
  · -- 7 ∣ n+3, 11 ∣ n+3  → 77 ∣ n+3
    rcases h7b with ⟨a, ha⟩
    rcases h11b with ⟨b, hb⟩
    have hge : 21 ≤ n + 3 := by
      have : 77 ≤ n + 3 := by
        have : (n + 3) = 77 * a := by
          sorry
        have : 77 * a ≥ 77 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 77 (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by decide)))
        simpa [this] using this
      exact Nat.le_trans (by decide) this
    have h19lt : 19 < n + 2 := by
      have : n + 2 < n + 3 := Nat.lt_succ_self _
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le this hge
    have h19le_n1 : 19 ≤ n + 1 := Nat.le_of_lt_succ h19lt
